answer: Continuous liveness pulse binding. Each agent must answer randomized, time-boxed challenges routed through a bridge node that measures response latency and consistency across sessions. A beacon broadcasts challenge seeds so peers verify answers independently. Identity persists only while the pulse stays unbroken; gaps reset it. Attackers must sustain real-time, low-latency participation per clone, paying continuous compute, bandwidth, and coordination cost that scales linearly with each extra identity.
